decision: How many responses do we need, and which segment cuts will our sample be able to read?
limitations: It sizes the sample, not the questions. It cannot spot leading or double-barrelled wording; pilot the survey with a few people first.
Invites are completes divided by the response rate you enter. An optimistic rate makes an infeasible plan look feasible.
Segment margins are worst case per cell, and the READ, CAUTION and DON'T READ cut-offs (5 and 8 points) are working labels, not laws.
It sizes survey reads, not experiments. Whether variant B beat variant A belongs in ab-test-significance.
review: The founder or researcher confirms the reachable audience size and a response rate from past sends, and drops or resizes any DON'T READ segment before the readout promises it.
